_comment: L1 plan Task 15 (docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-14-l1-curated-library.md): Schumann, Album for the Young, Op. 68 (Mutopia engravings by Philippe Hézaine from the Peters edition, CC BY-SA 2.5 / 3.0) and Tchaikovsky, Album for the Young, Op. 39 (public-domain Mutopia engravings from the Schirmer 1904 edition). Facts from content/tools/candidates.json and the fetched RDF. Levels: the per-piece levels of Henle's Urtext edition HN 45 (https://www.henle.de/en/Album-for-the-Young-op.-68/HN-45, read 2026-10-14) calibrated on the two core pieces of the set (No. 1 Melody: Henle 2, our level 2; No. 8 Wild Rider: Henle 3, our level 3), with the level heuristic's proposal (tools/level.py). 'rejected' keeps the full catalog entry ('piece') of the three pieces blocked only by the xmlcheck grace-note count, so they can be reinstated unchanged once it is fixed.

rejected.reason: Blocked by a checker limitation, not by the score: the LilyPond 2.24 MIDI check reports 2 notes 'only in the MIDI' (the A4 acciaccatura at quarters 136.885 and 142.885 of the unfolded MIDI, the second playing of a grace note inside a repeated section). xmlcheck.best_midi_match accepts unmatched MIDI grace notes up to grace_pitches(xs), which counts grace notes as written, not along the unfolded order. With the grace notes counted along xmlcheck.unfold_order the check is exact (612/612, nothing only in either). Every other gate passed when built (validation OK, 0 lint errors at medium and large, no span flag, level proposal 3, 110,840 bytes).
rejected.reinstate: after the coordinator's xmlcheck fix: move 'piece' back into 'pieces', then build.py --only and gates.py --only this slug

rejected.reason: Blocked by a checker limitation, not by the score. First, the converter dropped the final repeat sign: the source pads the last bar (3/4, which completes the pickup of the repeated second section) with spacer rests to 4/4, and ly2musicxml takes the piece's end from the last note, so LilyPond's ':|.' at the padded bar line matched no measure end (unfolded check 466/684). The two catalog patches in 'piece.convert' remove the padding spacers, so the last bar is the 3/4 bar the print shows and the backward repeat is exported; the check then matched 682/682 with 1 note 'only in the MIDI': the bass grace note C3 (bar 6, inside the repeated first section) played the second time, the same xmlcheck grace-count limitation as Nos. 7 and 18. With the grace notes counted along xmlcheck.unfold_order the check is exact (682/682). Every other gate passed when built (validation OK, 0 lint errors at medium and large, no span flag, level proposal 3, 132,824 bytes). The published Mutopia MIDI keeps the padding, so with the patches it differs after the first repeat (500/682); that is the expected, documented difference of a patched source.
rejected.reinstate: after the coordinator's xmlcheck fix: move 'piece' back into 'pieces', then build.py --only and gates.py --only this slug

rejected.reason: Spare for No. 26 (level 4); tried in a scratch conversion, not used. The LilyPond 2.24 MIDI check matched 323/789: the source pads the first ending of the B section ('g4. ~ g4 s8') with a spacer, so LilyPond's unfolded MIDI leaves an eighth of silence before the repeated pickup while the MusicXML first ending is 2.5 quarters (the spacer is not a note), and every later note is offset by an eighth. It also has a grace note (b16 cis) inside a repeated section, which the xmlcheck grace-count limitation of Nos. 7, 18 and 26 would report. Fixing both needs three or more source patches plus the checker fix.
